name: Multivitamin Gummies
subtitle: Nutritionist Developed formula to boost energy, immunity, balance hormone levels and relieve stress
usageInstructions: Eat 1 gummy daily after a heavy meal.
description: Be Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies fulfil nutrient deficiencies in your body resulting in better energy, metabolism and less stress improving overall health. Why do you need these Multivitamin Gummies?: Women in their mid-20s and above often have diets that lack adequate nutrition - leading to fatigue, low metabolism, and vitamin deficiencies. Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies are rich in 9 essential vitamins and 3 minerals that help fulfil these deficiencies. Boosts immunity and energy level: Women with Iron, Folic Acid, Zinc, Vitamin B5 and B12 deficiencies feel tired and are prone to the common cold. Enriched with these nutrients and more - regular intake helps boost energy levels and strengthen your immunity, which leads to better health. Balances hormone level: A dip in your mental health, i.e. frequent anxious thoughts, can be due to vitamin and mineral deficiencies. Vitamin D3 and B6 in these gummies help boost serotonin levels in the brain and regulate insulin levels which help balance hormone levels. Relieves stress: Antioxidants such as Vitamin A, C, and E protect your body from free radical damage, reducing anxiety. Vitamin D3 and B6 also play an important role in alleviating stress. Health and taste friendly: Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies have a tangy Orange flavour. This makes it better, easy and tastier than having pills. 9 Vitamins and 3 Minerals - all combined in vegetarian gummy with no added refined sugar, no preservatives and no added colours.

list.title: Do vitamin gummies really work?
list.content: Gummies with vitamins works at par with vitamin tablets and capsules taken - the composition of the ingredients matter.Taking these gummies would help fulfil deficiencies leading to better health.

list.title: What multivitamins should I take daily for a woman?
list.content: This varies from person to person and is also dependent on the diet (vegetarian v non-vegetarian diet) but in general women in India are prone to  deficiencies of Iron, Vitamin B complex,  Magnesium, Vitamin D and others.

list.title: Do gummy vitamins make you gain weight?
list.content: No. Multivitamin Gummies don't lead to weight gain- please see the nutritional chart for further clarity

list.title: How many multivitamin gummies should I take a day?
list.content: Each formula is different. One should never exceed the recommended dosage of multivitamin supplements - for our gummies: once a day does the trick!

list.title: Do women's gummy vitamins work?
list.content: When taken with a proper diet and following a lifestyle, multivitamins for women work.

list.title: Can multivitamins cause acne?
list.content: Acne is a condition that is caused due to bacterial infestation or hormonal levels. Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies don't lead to acne until taken as recommended.

list.title: Is taking multivitamins safe?
list.content: Yes, Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies are completely safe to consume

list.title: Can multivitamins boost your energy?
list.content: Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies contain components like Iron, Zinc, Folic Acid, Vitamin B-complex, Vitamin D, Vitamin A and E, which help boost energy and metabolism levels.

list.title: Are Gummies Better Than Tablets?
list.content: Gummies are a better alternative to tablets, as they have a pleasant taste, are easy to consume and digest, and do not cause any discomfort or irritation in the stomach. Many people, especially children and the elderly find swallowing tablets difficult, making gummies a preferred option. Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies have a tangy orange flavour, making them a tastier and more enjoyable way to consume essential vitamins and minerals.

list.title: Is It Good to Take Multivitamin Gummies Everyday?
list.content: Yes, it is safe to take Multivitamin Gummies every day, provided you do not exceed the recommended dosage. The recommended dosage for Bodywise Multivitamin Gummies is two gummies per day. Overconsumption of vitamins and minerals can lead to toxicity and cause health problems. It is always best to consult an expert or a qualified nutritionist to determine your daily vitamin and mineral requirements.

list.title: What Age is Gummy Multivitamin for?
list.content: Multivitamin gummies are suitable for adults of all ages with nutrient deficiencies. However, it is always best to consult an expert or a qualified nutritionist to determine your daily vitamin and mineral requirements.

list.title: Are Gummies Good for Hair Growth?
list.content: Several key nutrients are important for promoting hair growth, such as biotin, vitamin E, and vitamin C. Many multivitamin gummies contain these nutrients and can therefore be beneficial for supporting hair health and growth
